items.text: smartPOA now checks for new versions and updates itself, including on phones and home-screen installs. If you are in the middle of entering something, it waits and shows an Update button instead of interrupting you.
This window appears once after each update. You can reopen it anytime from What's new at the bottom of the menu.
You can add smartPOA to your phone's home screen for a full-screen, app-style view. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
Use the Feedback button in the top bar to report a problem, suggest a feature or ask a question. Replies appear under Your earlier feedback.
Feedback inbox under Administration lists every message, with status, replies and CSV export.
New Past checkrides tab with outcome totals, filters by year, applicant, certificate and result, attempt numbers and CSV export.

releases.title: Records from the previous POA program

items.text: Applicants, aircraft and checkride records from the previous plan of action program were brought into smartPOA.
Data Review tab lists records flagged for correction, plus automatic checks that clear once a record is fixed.
Checkride scheduling and outcome records, and AI-assisted scenario drafting that you review before use.
